name: 马蒂亚斯·施莱登
bio_short: 德国植物学家，细胞学说的共同创始人。他通过显微镜观察植物组织，提出“所有植物都是由细胞组成的”，这一发现与施旺的工作共同奠定了现代生物学的基础。
bio_short_en: A German botanist and co-founder of the cell theory. Through microscopic observation of plant tissues, he proposed that 'all plants are composed of cells', a discovery that, together with Schwann's work, laid the foundation for modern biology.
